issues.problem: Cue (a remake with the same plot, only new actors) equally called for 换汤不换药 (gy085, same set): a change in form, not substance.
issues.action: Rewrote the cue as an author's 'new' book that is just old essays put together again; added 换汤不换药 to near with the difference.

issues.problem: Cue said the intern was 'trying to tidy up' the drive, which points to 帮倒忙 (gy093, trying to help but making things worse).
issues.action: Rewrote the cue as a careless wrong command that wipes the database and leaves the team to fix it, so it no longer involves trying to help.

issues.problem: Cue (a classmate lends savings when you go bankrupt) and ctx 3 (lends money and helps after a business failure) fit 及时雨 (gy055) and 雪中送炭 (timely help) as well; the risk and sacrifice that set this idiom apart were missing.
issues.action: Rewrote the cue around standing by a friend at the cost of one's own job and savings; rewrote ctx 3 so a classmate risks angering the boss to testify for a falsely accused friend.

issues.problem: Story is null. Popular accounts link the phrase to Qin Qiong in Sui-Tang folk fiction, but the details and the source are disputed.
issues.action: Left the story null on purpose rather than attach an uncertain origin.
